title: The Coordinate Pythagorean Theorem from Planar Isotropy: An Axiomatic Derivation with Lie-Theoretic Extensions
description:
Versioned research software and accompanying mathematical manuscript. Alessandro Odasso initiated the research question, asking whether ChatGPT could find an original proof of the Pythagorean theorem. The original manuscript was generated by OpenAI ChatGPT (GPT-6, High thinking effort); subsequent manuscript revisions and Lean formalization were AI-assisted. The terms 'original proof' and 'alternative derivation' describe a research question, not an independently verified claim of historical novelty.

The Lean 4/Mathlib theorem derives a^2+b^2=c^2 from explicit assumptions involving a primitive length function, axial calibration, mirror symmetry, a linear additive action containing an oriented quarter-turn, rigidity, and axis reachability for the chosen vector. It does not define the primitive length by the Cartesian Euclidean norm. Theorems were checked by public GitHub Actions, including a kernel-level axiom audit. These conditional proofs do not establish independence or minimality of the geometric hypotheses, nor do they establish the existence of the entire group action from weaker incidence axioms. See README.md and AXIOMS.md.
